lines.en: : Thank fucking God. I was dying of boredom.
lines.zh: : 他妈的谢天谢地。我都快无聊死了。

lines.en: : Please, {i}please{/i} do something with me before my brain starts to ooze out of my ears.
lines.zh: : 拜托，{i}拜托{/i}陪我干点什么吧，不然我的脑子就要从耳朵里流出来了。

lines.en: : I will certainly do my best to prevent that from happening.
lines.zh: : 那我一定尽力阻止这种事发生。

lines.en: : Did you want to go into your-
Kirin and I spend the night in the hallway instead of going into her room for whatever reason.
lines.zh: 不知为什么，Kirin 和我没进她房间，而是在走廊里待了一晚。

lines.en: I get feeling cooped up sometimes, but what is it about standing around in the hallway that seemed so alluring to her tonight?
lines.zh: 我有时会觉得憋得慌，可今晚站在走廊里到底有什么吸引她的？

lines.en: She probably just wants the others to see me hanging out with her.
lines.zh: 她大概只是想让别人看见她跟我待在一起。

lines.en: Or at least that's what I imagine is going through her head.
lines.zh: 至少我是这么猜她脑子里在想什么的。

lines.en: Regardless, we talk for an hour or so before deciding to call it a night, and I find myself heading back home having accomplished virtually nothing today.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我们聊了一个来小时才决定就此打住，然后我发现自己回到家，今天几乎什么都没做成。
